Compare configured selection output with unanimous human decisions.

Source: R/curation_metrics.R
curation_selection_vs_human.Rd

Evaluation filters the requested review source before applying the existing unanimous consensus_reviews() rule. The default eval_source = "random" preserves the legacy unbiased evaluation path.

Usage

curation_selection_vs_human(
  records,
  reviews,
  config = NULL,
  eval_source = "random",
  by_country = FALSE,
  selection_col = "selected"
)

Arguments

records

Records containing country, document_id, and the selected logical column.

reviews

Review rows with canonical or legacy reviewer identity.

config

Optional configuration used to scope explicit project/corpus columns.

eval_source

Review source(s) to evaluate, defaulting to "random"; NULL evaluates all sources.

by_country

If TRUE, prepend country with an all row.

selection_col

Name of the logical selection column, default "selected".

Value

One metrics row, country metrics, or NULL when no agreed labels match the records.
